scope: historically developed five-source-region benchmark; current-fold supervised/fit/selection isolation; not independent new-event test
inner_split: S05E frozen alternative spatial partition, restricted to four non-held regions

recipe.gradient_accumulation: four checkpointed microbatch forward graphs; single full-batch BCE+Dice backward, never average microbatch Dice
recipe.decoder: unchanged 2304->128 GN8 GELU; upsample conv 128/64/32; 1 logit; identical seeded decoder per pair

initialization.pretrained: official frozen encoder initialization, all encoder parameters then trainable
initialization.scratch: Linear trunc_normal std .02 bias0; LayerNorm weight1 bias0; patch Conv PyTorch default; cls_token trunc_normal .02; generated 12x12 512D sincos interpolated to16x16, generated 3x256 channel sincos, channel_cls zero
initialization.decoder_seed: same seed and construction before encoder reinitialization; no extra random decoder init
initialization.only_arm_difference: encoder initialization including deterministic positional initialization; all trainable tensors identical in shape

optimization.weight_decay_exclusions: bias, norm, cls, position and channel embeddings

environment.pair_environment: exact equality for torch/torchvision/numpy/cuda/cudnn/GPU across arms and resumed sessions

determinism.scope: same torch/numpy/CUDA/cuDNN/GPU class; no cross-hardware bitwise claim

recipe.loss: weighted BCE + one global batch Dice smoothing1; sqrt(negative/positive) clipped1..20
recipe.sampling: 4 positive + 4 background with replacement; torch CPU generator seed+1000; same named source IDs order
recipe.augmentation: batch-wide rot90 and horizontal flip; independent CPU generator seed+3000; no other augmentation
recipe.normalization: fold train IDs only; float64 moments over pixels, std floor0.0001; never reuse S05E five-region fit

model_selection.score: equal mean of four inner-region F1 from pooled pixel counts within each region
model_selection.tie_break: earliest step using exact rational F1 comparison
model_selection.zero_denominator: score zero for inner selection only; do not drop a region; raw undefined metric also stored as null

primary_metric: mean over 5 regions of mean over 3 paired seeds of regional F1(P)-regional F1(S), fixed 20k

uncertainty.block_key: region:floor(center_x/5120):floor(center_y/5120), in each region fixed projected CRS, origin zero
uncertainty.draw: B_r draws with replacement from the sorted occupied blocks of each region; all tiles of sampled blocks count with multiplicity
uncertainty.empty_positive_or_zero_f1_denominator: mark whole paired macro replicate invalid; no redrawing or region removal
uncertainty.interval: 2.5/97.5 quantiles of jointly valid replicates; report validity count
uncertainty.scope: conditional on fixed trained models, five regions, three seeds and observed caches; no refit/new-region/history uncertainty
uncertainty.block_order: numeric lexicographic (block_x,block_y), region order as regions
uncertainty.draw_order: replicate outer loop 0..1999; regions inner loop in protocol order; one integers(0,B_r,size=B_r) call per region; block weights via bincount
uncertainty.legal_missing_values: undefined secondary metrics and unavailable CI are JSON null; invalid replicates are masked, never serialized as NaN

decision_rules.F1: quality sufficient; primary gain>=0.01 and CI lower>0, >=4/5 region gains>0 and >=2/3 seed-macro gains>0
decision_rules.F2: quality sufficient; primary gain<=-0.01 and CI upper<0, >=4/5 region gains<0 and >=2/3 seed-macro gains<0
decision_rules.F3: quality sufficient; abs primary gain<=0.005, CI entirely within [-0.01,0.01], all 5 absolute region gains<=0.01
decision_rules.F4: all other technically complete cases, including quality insufficient; report heterogeneity/insufficient support; no new algorithm inference
decision_rules.quality: every run outer20k has TP>0, each run AMP skips<=1%, >=20 occupied blocks each region, primary jointly valid bootstrap>=1800
decision_rules.technical_failure: missing/duplicate/hash/ID/fit/selection errors or unexpected NaN/Inf/illegal missing values: INCOMPLETE or TECHNICAL_FAILURE, decision null; predefined nulls and insufficient bootstrap support are legal and handled by F4
